The '''Nute hive''' was the most influential [[hive-family]] on the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidia]]. They adopted a Neimoidian known as [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Gunray]], who acquired their clan name of Nute. [[Gender/Legends|He]] quickly rose to the top of each successive corporate level of the family, with some of his textbook examples of double-dealing being taught at Nute hive seminars for [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after.<ref name="Fact File" /> In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]],<ref name="The Essential Reader's Companion">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] gave Gunray inside information about a Neimoidian business rival<ref name="Fact File 2014">{{FactFile2014|33|GUN 1-6|Nute Gunray}}</ref> who posed the greatest threat to his supremacy in the hive clan, whom he quickly disposed of his thereafter.<ref name="Fact File" />
